label: Getting started
summary: Minimums, account setup, and choosing an investment.

questions.question: What is the minimum amount of money I can invest?
questions.answer: The minimum amount of money you can invest is $1,000.

questions.question: How do I choose an investment product?
questions.answer: Start with your financial goal, time horizon, and risk tolerance. Our team can help you compare the available products.

label: Products & management
summary: Available products and how portfolios are managed.

questions.question: What types of investment products do you offer?
questions.answer: We offer stocks, bonds, mutual funds, and tailored portfolios designed for a range of investment objectives.

questions.question: Is my investment portfolio managed by professionals?
questions.answer: Yes. Our experienced financial professionals actively manage portfolios with the goal of balancing returns and risk.

label: Access & timing
summary: Withdrawals, access rules, and investment duration.

questions.question: How often can I access my investment funds?
questions.answer: You can request access to your funds at any time, subject to the terms and conditions of the investment product you selected.

questions.question: What is the typical investment duration for your products?
questions.answer: Durations vary. We offer both short-term and long-term options so you can select a time horizon that fits your financial goals.
